key_insight: Pretrained vehicle-aerodynamics surrogates transfer unreliably, while GeoReplay preserves source-domain accuracy without sacrificing fine-tuning’s target accuracy.
engineering_relevance: GeoReplay could help reuse aerodynamic surrogates across vehicle classes while limiting accuracy loss on previously modeled designs.
method: Benchmark five DrivAerML-pretrained surrogates on four independent target datasets.
Replay source simulations with geometries resembling the target vehicles.
Apply replay updates only when aligned with the target gradient.
evidence_signal: Fine-tuning beat training from scratch in fewer than half of comparisons; GeoReplay reduced source error relative to fine-tuning in 77 of 80 settings while matching target accuracy.
watch_item: GeoReplay requires retained source simulations, and its guarantee concerns sufficiently small steps on the target training objective—not unseen-target accuracy.
paper_title: Measuring and Improving Transfer of Neural Surrogates for Vehicle Aerodynamics
